<b>Мультиполярный нейрон</b>: один аксон: Multipolar neuron: one axon and many dendrites, the most common type in the brain. This is a spinal cord motor neuron: its myelinated axon runs to a muscle, sometimes for more than a meter. The collateral branches off at a right angle and copies the signal to a second target.
<b>Псевдоуниполярный нейрон</b>: один ко: Pseudounipolar neuron: one short process near the cell body splits in the shape of a T (in development it is a bipolar neuron whose processes have fused). One branch runs to the skin, the other into the CNS; in fast touch fibers both are myelinated, and the signal bypasses the cell body.
<b>Клетка Пуркинье</b> мозжечка: с неё в: Purkinje cell of the cerebellum: neurocytology began with it in 1837. 2–3 thick dendrites leave the cell body and branch into a huge tree in a single plane. Motor memory is stored at its synapses. Turn the scene sideways, and the tree becomes a thin strip.
Сеть из пяти нейронов. <b>Сенсорный</b>: A network of five neurons. The sensory neuron (input) detects a touch on the skin, two interneurons pass the signal around a loop, and the muscle twitches several times. The motor neuron (output) controls the muscle. Transmitter: glutamate in central synapses, acetylcholine at the muscle.
<b>Окраска по Гольджи</b>: сначала бихро: Golgi stain: first potassium dichromate gives an orange background, then silver nitrate is added. Silver chromate forms, and the whole cell turns black, down to the finest dendritic twigs.
<b>Brainbow</b>: случайные сочетания флу: Brainbow: random combinations of fluorescent proteins from jellyfish and coral produce about 100 hues, so each cell can be traced through the tangle.
<b>Сердце.</b> Боль при стенокардии и ин: Heart. Angina and heart-attack pain is felt behind the breastbone and on the left, spreading to the left arm (along the inner side), the neck and the lower jaw. Sensory fibers from the heart enter the spinal cord at T1–T4, where nerves from the skin of the chest and the inner side of the arm also arrive (T1–T2, and C8 at the little finger). The neck and jaw: via the vagus nerve and the cervical segments.
<b>Почему боль «переезжает».</b> Волокна: Why pain “moves”. Fibers from the heart (red impulse) run through the sympathetic trunk and the white ramus into the spinal nerve; the neuron cell bodies lie in the dorsal root ganglion. In the dorsal horn they converge with fibers from the skin (blue impulse) on one neuron whose axon goes to the thalamus. The brain is used to signals from the skin and attributes the pain to it.
<b>Трубчатая кость</b> (схема бедренной): A long bone (here a schematic femur) cut lengthwise. The diaphysis is a wall of compact bone around a canal with yellow marrow. The epiphyses are a thin shell and spongy bone of trabeculae with red marrow. The ends are covered with hyaline cartilage, the rest with periosteum. The white line is the growth plate; the frame marks where the osteons are taken from.
<b>Остеон</b> (гаверсова система) — един: An osteon (Haversian system) is the unit of compact bone: 4–20 concentric lamellae of collagen and mineral around a central canal with a capillary and a nerve. In the lacunae between them sit osteocytes (purple), linked by their processes to each other and to the canal. Volkmann’s canals bring vessels from the periosteum. Bone is 2/3 mineral and 1/3 collagen.
<b>Остеопороз</b>: остеокласты разрушают: Osteoporosis: osteoclasts break bone down faster than osteoblasts build it (menopause, glucocorticoids). There are fewer trabeculae, they are thinner, the compact layer is thinned and the osteon canals are wider. Typical fractures — femoral neck, vertebrae, distal radius. Diagnosis — densitometry; treatment — calcium with vitamin D, bisphosphonates.
<b>Синовиальный сустав</b> на срезе. Кон: A synovial joint in section. The congruent surfaces are covered with smooth hyaline cartilage (blue), which is nourished by the synovial fluid; friction in it is lower than ice on ice. The fluid is produced by the synovial membrane (pink). The fibrous capsule continues into the periosteum, and ligaments lie outside it.
<b>Остеоартроз</b> — самая частая болезн: Osteoarthritis is the most common joint disease: cartilage wears away (age, injuries, excess weight), the joint space narrows, bone beneath the cartilage becomes denser, and bony spurs — osteophytes — grow at the margins. Movement is limited, there is crepitus, pain on loading, and brief morning stiffness. Treatment — exercise, weight loss, painkillers, and joint replacement when the joint is destroyed.
<b>Ревматоидный артрит</b> — аутоиммунно: Rheumatoid arthritis is autoimmune inflammation of the synovial membrane: it grows into pannus (red), which creeps over the cartilage and eats into the bone (erosions). There is an effusion, the joint is swollen and hot, morning stiffness lasts more than an hour; small joints of the hands and feet are affected symmetrically. Treatment — methotrexate and biologic drugs.
<b>Подагра</b>: при уровне урата выше ~4: Gout: when urate exceeds about 420 µmol/L, needle-shaped crystals of sodium urate (white) precipitate in the joint fluid. Neutrophils attack them, and overnight intense inflammation develops — most often in the big toe joint. The crystals show negative birefringence; in chronic gout nodules (tophi) form.
<b>Мыщелковый сустав</b> — два округлых: A condylar joint — two rounded condyles on almost flat facets: flexion–extension, and rotation too when flexed (two axes). The main example is the knee, the largest joint in the body: its surfaces do not match, so cartilaginous menisci lie between them, and cruciate ligaments inside.
